name: Portfolio Optimization

concepts.concept: Portfolio weights, budget constraint, net vs gross exposure, bounds

concepts.concept: Maximum-Sharpe (tangency) portfolio and risk-free rate sensitivity

concepts.lecture: 01-09 Optimizers: How to Optimize a Portfolio

sources.chapter: Ch. 10 Modern Portfolio Theory: The Efficient Frontier and Portfolio Optimization
sources.note: Sharpe = slope of ray from origin; the frontier point on the steepest ray has the highest Sharpe. (Course-assigned for a later week; not an Exam-1 reading.)
